purpose: First executable and quotient-priced MLP3 family; legacy input/output projections are structural evidence only because they still execute the checkpoint MLP.

legacy_evidence.reason: The projected input is passed through mo.Left, mo.Right, and mo.Down from the original checkpoint.
The hook computes mo_full = blk.mlp(z) before projecting its output.

family.architecture_rationale: The exact residual ledger identifies same-block attention and the predecessor MLP as the local writers available at block 3. The token table captures the established lexical component; the affine map tests whether MLP3's matcher-evidence re-encoding is a low-rank local DAG edge.

table.exception_rule: largest fit-row token counts, ties by ascending token id

family.nesting: one frozen reduced-rank ridge decomposition in the penalized input-covariance metric; every candidate is an exact prefix without refit
family.fit_loss: table fit first; for its residual minimize ||Y-XW||_F^2+lambda||W||_F^2 at each rank using the truncated SVD of (Xc.T@Xc+lambda*I)^(-1/2) Xc.T@Yc, with lambda=0.01*mean(diag(Xc.T@Xc))

codec.singular_strata: reject selected repeated, near-repeated, zero, or nonfinite singular strata rather than claiming canonical bytes
codec.quantization_selection: finest power-of-two step whose every required encoded stream fits signed int32; freeze before evaluation

operational_lanes.composition: same exact hashes under canonical all-attention rank32+roster v8
operational_lanes.extraction: install decoded program output and report optimal-anchor fidelity
operational_lanes.removal: subtract decoded program minus its saved optimal constant; fixed-seed signed output permutation is the norm-matched control

artifact: all tensors derive only from fit member
all six streams decode and reproduce their hash
causal: full median lexical22 matched-removal excess CE > 0
preregistered_gates.representation_falsifier: Reject the affine family as MLP3's sufficient representation language if full rank misses any held-out, causal, or OOD gate, even if its isolated CE is favorable. Escalate to an explicitly priced quadratic residual only after that result.
